e22-3yp-Echo.title: Echo
e22-3yp-Echo.description: Echo 🤟 — Every Gesture Has a Voice. An assistive smart-glove system that bridges communication barriers by translating Sign Language gestures into speech using flex sensors, an ESP32, and machine learning. Built to make communication more accessible, with motion-based recognition and neural networks planned for future development.

e22-3yp-Smart_STEM_Experiment_Kit.title: Smart_STEM_Experiment_Kit
e22-3yp-Smart_STEM_Experiment_Kit.description: Reusable STEM experiment kit for school classrooms. One base unit with six swappable sensor modules lets students run many experiments. A touchscreen shows live data, a web dashboard helps teachers, and an AI engine flags unusual readings and explains results simply. CO3060, Dept. of Computer Engineering, University of Peradeniya.

e22-3yp-Syncrobots.title: Syncrobots
e22-3yp-Syncrobots.description: Infrastructure-free formation control for low-cost robot swarms using Ultra-Wideband (UWB) ranging instead of cameras, markers, or GPS. Each follower tracks distances to both the global leader and its immediate predecessor, damping chain oscillations and enabling affordable multi-robot experimentation for student teams.

e22-3yp-Ventra.title: Ventra
e22-3yp-Ventra.description: Ventra is a low-cost, real-time Bag-Valve-Mask (BVM) ventilation feedback and training system using ESP32-S3, airflow and pressure sensors, and an offline dashboard to measure ventilation performance, provide corrective feedback, and support objective manikin-based training and OSCE assessment.
